info.name: CNPM Backend API
info.description: Postman collection for the CNPM backend mounted at `/api/v1`. Modules: health-check, auth, user/users, address/addresses, image, inventory, product/products, role/roles, shop/shops, storefront, warehouse/warehouses, category/categories. All authenticated routes use bearer access tokens; `/auth/logout` and `/auth/refresh-token` use the refresh token; `/storefront/*` is public and supports anonymous reads.

item.name: User
item.description: Singleton current-user routes defined by `src/api/user/user.router.ts` and list route `src/api/user/users.router.ts`. The singleton routes infer the user from the access token's `userId`.

item.name: Address
item.description: Routes defined by `src/api/address/address.router.ts` (mutations) and `src/api/address/addresses.router.ts` (list). The bound user is resolved from the access token; the `userId` field is still validated by the schema, so it must be present in the request.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Home",
  "addressLine": "123 Main St",
  "city": "Ho Chi Minh",
  "district": "District 1",
  "state": "Ho Chi Minh",
  "country": "Vietnam",
  "isPrimary": true
}

{
  "name": "Home (Updated)",
  "addressLine": "456 Updated St",
  "city": "Ho Chi Minh",
  "district": "District 3",
  "state": "Ho Chi Minh",
  "country": "Vietnam",
  "isPrimary": true
}

item.name: Image
item.description: Routes defined by `src/api/image/image.router.ts`. `prefix` must be one of `product-image` | `user-avatar`. `extension` must be one of `jpg` | `jpeg` | `png`. `size` is bytes and capped at 25 MB.

item.name: Role
item.description: Routes defined by `src/api/role/role.router.ts` (mutations) and `src/api/role/roles.router.ts` (list + permissions catalog).

item.name: Shop
item.description: Routes defined by `src/api/shop/shop.router.ts`. A user may own only one shop (`shops.owner_id` is unique). `status` transitions: PENDING → ACTIVE, ACTIVE ↔ SUSPENDED. Shop GET handlers expect an `idOrSlug` request param.

item.name: Category
item.description: Routes defined by `src/api/category/category.router.ts` (mutations + tree) and `src/api/category/categories.router.ts` (system list). System categories have `shopId = null`; shop-scoped categories carry the caller's `assignedShopId` from the JWT. `parentId` is immutable; deletes soft-cascade the whole subtree. Max depth is 4 (root depth 0).

item.name: Warehouse
item.description: Routes defined by `src/api/warehouse/warehouse.router.ts` (mutations + read one) and `src/api/warehouse/warehouses.router.ts` (paginated list). The `shopId` is injected from the caller's `assignedShopId` JWT claim — it is never accepted in the request body. `addressId` must reference an `addresses` row whose `shopId` matches the caller. `code` is unique within a shop. Setting `isDefault: true` clears the previous default.
